stem.x: Which of the following is an appropriate operation for user authentication that uses an IC card and a PIN?

b.x: Given that each user can be identified by an IC card, a common PIN is set for all users in order to reduce the management workload.
If an IC card is lost, a new IC card is issued, and after the PIN is reset, the lost IC card is deactivated.
The PIN is set by combining the numeric information imprinted on the surface of the IC card.
When an IC card is delivered, the PIN is not enclosed, but is notified to the user through another channel.
